## Summary

Describe the user-visible outcome and the boundary changed.

## Validation

- [ ] `bun run check`
- [ ] Tests cover success and failure behavior
- [ ] Documentation matches the implementation
- [ ] User-visible change includes a Changeset

## Safety and compatibility

- [ ] No sensitive session data is included
- [ ] Unsupported provider state is reported explicitly
- [ ] Filesystem or installer changes include confinement/integrity coverage
- [ ] Schema changes declare compatibility and migration impact
